text:
Ruth (AE): Heads-up 10am PT kickoff with LyraHealth tomorrow. They asked for a 2h soak: sustained 520 qps, outputs ~640 tokens, p99 <210ms, errors <0.7%. Need run plan, sizing, and quick cost delta for burst nodes / multi-az. Can SE/SRE + Solutions scope quickly?
Ben (SE): On it. Quick clarifications: streaming % and how cacheable are prompts? Any real trace we should mimic?
Ruth (AE): 55% streaming, ~48% repeatable templates (good cache hit). No full trace yet 1 will get a sample tomorrow but want an internal validation first.
Ben (SE): Proposed plan: warmup 15m, ramp 10m to 520 qps, 2h steady, 10m cooldown. Arrival pattern: Poisson + periodic microbursts: 3x for 45s every 20m. Models to test: rwd-7b-q8 (latency), rwd-13b-q4 (balance), rwd-14b-8k (quality). Enable prefix KV cache and first-token streaming. Suggest max_batch_delay 7ms initially.
Ben (SE): sample load command:
```
rwd-load --model rwd-13b-q4 --target-qps 520 --duration 7800 --ramp 600 --warmup 900 --burst-profile "every_20m:45s@3x" --concurrency 85 --payload-dist lyra_prompts.json
```
Hana (SRE): Infra rec: Dedicated pool sized for 630 qps (20% headroom). Autoscale min=1 max=3, cooldown 90s. Multi-AZ for demo. Fallback: 13b->7b. Pre-warm KV. Recommend enabling autoscale buffer to spin new node ~60s before expected burst windows if we know schedule.
Omar (Solutions): Pricing rough: Dedicated pool (13b-q4) ~ $1,050/hr to sustain 520 qps. 2h run + warmup ~= $2.6k. Burst-ready config (extra node reserved) adds ~+18% hourly. Multi-AZ premium ~+12%. Hosted token billing rough: $0.20 / 1k inferred tokens - will refine with real token counts.
load-bot: smoke run summary:
```json
{"test":"lyra-smoke-2026-04-10","target_qps":520,"sustained_qps":525,"p50_ms":45,"p95_ms":125,"p99_ms":216,"error_rate_pct":0.5,"gpu_util_pct":80,"notes":"p99 216ms slightly over 210ms SLO. Options: bump +15% capacity or lower max_batch_delay to 5ms. 7b model p99 ~185ms but need quality check."}
```
Ben (SE): p99 216ms 1 close. Fastest path to SLO: spin +15% capacity and rerun a 30m validation. If still high, reduce max_batch_delay to 5ms. Which should we try first?
Hana (SRE): I'll provision +15% now and schedule a 30m validation in ~45m. If we still miss SLO we'll try the batch_delay change. Also will pre-populate KV during ramp to reduce cold misses.
Omar (Solutions): I'll update the pricing sheet with two options: (A) baseline (B) +15% reserved/burst ready and include multi-az delta. Also prepping redacted SOC answers for LyraHealth; will DM when ready.
Ruth (AE): Acceptance criteria: sustained 520 qps, p99 <210ms, <0.7% errors for 2h. If validation passes we schedule customer soak + demo. Post validation results here.
Ben (SE): running 30m validation at 520 qps in ~1h. Will post short results.
load-bot: 30m validation results:
```json
{"test":"lyra-val-2026-04-10","target_qps":520,"sustained_qps":523,"p50_ms":42,"p95_ms":118,"p99_ms":198,"error_rate_pct":0.3,"gpu_util_pct":74,"note":"p99 198ms meets <210ms SLO with +15% capacity and KV pre-warm. Recommend final 2h soak with same config and KV population."}
```
Ruth (AE): Great 1 that's within acceptance. I'll offer two pricing lines to Lyra: baseline and burst-ready. Scheduling the customer soak for Tue. Thanks everyone :rocket:
